comments.author: Hernan
comments.body:
I did some digging and this appears to be the 4th quest in quest chain:
1. (GT) Bluebird of the Far East (Bio 6) Hangzhou - discover Lidth's Jay
2 (GT) Blue bird right height (Bio 5) Santo Domingo - discover Bluejay
3. Archive Map (Bio 5) Small Bird Map in Lisbon - discover Black-capped Chickadee.
Leads to this quest:
4. (GT) Birds banded (Bio 5) Santo Domingo - discover Red-headed Woodpecker
